adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` (config/routes.rb) but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` does not persist any changes and simply re-renders the current `@embedding` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). On the client, `admin-embedding` controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})` (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), but the new `embedding.hbs` template has no button/action wired to `saveChanges` (it only has `addHost` and per-host save/delete). So the PUT endpoint is effectively a no-op and currently unused by the UI, which is a real diff-grounded scope/cleanup concern but not a user-facing defect given nothing depends on it.
